summary: PBDB's open API gives extinct/extant flags, ranks and occurrence counts for fossil taxa (8,065 extinct-flagged family-rank records under Metazoa) and Sepkoski's genus compendium is online; together with Catalogue of Life they cover the taxon-level counts, while species-level ancestry is not recorded anywhere found.
next_step: Pre-register how pseudoextinction is handled, then pull PBDB taxa for Paleozoic and Mesozoic orders and families and join to extant status; species-level survival would need phylogenetic links not found here.
obstacles_confirmed: No source found gives species-level ancestor-descendant links.
PBDB record count was not filtered to valid names or marine animals, so 8,065 is an upper bound on distinct families.
